services.name: Tandem skydiving
services.desc: It always sounds like the lead up to a joke, like discount sushi. While there are companies that utilize the Groupon platform to advertise skydiving, often the “deal” is far from spectacular. Looking into the fine print shows hidden fees that bring the true price of the skydive within a few dollars of the industry standard, and there is a reason for this, it is because aviation is expensive, and so is good help. Integrity is foundational for us, and so we are transparent with our pricing, what you see is what you get, and if you’re not happy, we’ll work with you to make it right.
